content: Review docs/phases/role-neutrality-polish.md (Phase 54), branch fix/role-neutrality-review-nits based on merged PR #33 / eeb3190. User requested local installation, then four review nits in a separate PR before publication. Plan: deduplicate role labels, neutralize console hints, strengthen direct-headless refusal test using original config and explicit log assertion, remove unused setup role-variable work while retaining compatibility APIs. Participant checking precedes config comparison in source, so test the actual reason rather than assume the branch diagnosis. No version increment, tag or downstream upgrades. Global uv tool and project venv now installed from merged local source as 3.12.0; global verified outside checkout. User has exact watcher restart command. Validation: diff check and roadmap check passed, 54 phases/14 edges. No suite run for plan-only changes.

Approved. Scope is exactly the four Phase 51 review nits, on fix/role-neutrality-review-nits atop merged eeb3190; heading slugs to role-neutrality-polish (matches cycle and plan doc); roadmap check ok (54 phases, 14 edges) and 'roadmap ready' lists it. Correction accepted on item 3: in HeadlessEngine.run_owed_turn the participant check runs before the cached-config comparison, so the existing test already hits the mismatch branch — my impl-r2 diagnosis was wrong; asserting the logged reason is the right strengthening. Item 4: keep get_template_variables/renderer callable as planned; only drop the unused substitution work and the misleading setup output. No version bump; the on_submit gate is the recorded run for the impl submission.
